description:
## Goal

New `widget.proto` alongside `tool.proto` in `packages/proto/schemas/agent-inbox/v1/domain/`. Defines `WidgetDefinition` and `WidgetManifest` per the research spec.

## Expected Work

- Author `widget.proto` with fields for id, name, description, category, tags, render contract (e.g., iframe-bridge path/selector), and any multi-instance prop shape.
- Generate Go + TS bindings via the existing proto tooling.
- Unit tests on a sample manifest.

## Acceptance

- Proto validates.
- Generated Go and TS types compile and are importable.
name: widget-proto-schema
title: Add widget.proto to the shared proto schemas
